title: Only integrate Prototype Release commits from poc/ after baseline 2c58edcd
summary: From baseline 2c58edcd onward, do not port intermediate WIP commits under poc/. Only port approved prototype commits whose subject starts with 'Prototype Release:' (first diffing 2c58edcd..<first_release_sha> -- poc/, then <prev_release_sha>..<next_release_sha> -- poc/).
rationale: Owner workflow rule (2026-11-24): the prototype agent commits WIP frequently and marks owner-approved releases with 'Prototype Release: <name>'. Tracked in docs/poc-sync-state.md so the Svelte integration agent only ports approved releases.
